title: Feedback-driven Add Card
html: Chosen behavior: new cards are added to the beginning.
css: .add-card{max-width:430px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:10px}.add-card form{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:end}.add-card label{display:grid;gap:5px;flex:1}.add-card input,.add-card button{padding:8px}.add-card button{cursor:pointer}.add-card .rule{font-size:.9rem;color:#555}.add-card ol{padding-left:26px}.add-card li{padding:4px 0}
js: const form=root.querySelector('form'),input=root.querySelector('[data-name]'),list=root.querySelector('[data-cards]'); const cards=()=>{const v=api.getState('cards');return Array.isArray(v)?v:[];}; const render=()=>{list.replaceChildren(...cards().map(name=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=name;return li;}));}; form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const name=input.value.trim();if(!name)return;api.setState('cards',[name,...cards()]);input.value='';render();input.focus();});render();
